title: Introducing Jira, GitLab and incident.io Integrations for Mastra Factory
summary: More ways to manage issues, feature requests, and incident follow-ups.
body_markdown:
Mastra Factory now supports three new intakes:[Jira](https://factory.mastra.ai/configure/jira) ,[GitLab](https://factory.mastra.ai/configure/gitlab) , and[incident.io](https://factory.mastra.ai/configure/incidentio) , giving you more ways to manage and resolve issues, feature requests, and incident follow-ups.


Your browser does not support the video tag.


We launched[Mastra Factory](https://mastra.ai/blog/announcing-mastra-factory) earlier this year with support for GitHub, Linear, and Slack, and followed up with the[beta](https://mastra.ai/blog/announcing-mastra-factory-beta) launch earlier this month. Today, Jira, GitLab and incident.io join the intake lineup.


The intake column in Factory can be filtered by source, letting you see where each issue has come from. Open an item to read the full issue description, then move it through your pipeline until the work is complete.


Watch our recent workshop[Build and Own Your Software Factory](https://www.youtube.com/live/LzZ_FptHWqs?si=jPRw7FdghAKXOavn) to learn more.


## Get started


Every intake provider ships as part of the` @mastra/factory` package:


Terminal


```text
npm   install   @mastra/factory@latest
```


note


Requires` @mastra/factory@0.16.0` or later, added in[PR #20579](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/20579) ,[PR #23327](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/23327) , and[PR #24604](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/24604) .


Add credentials for each intake to` .env` , then configure them under **Settings → Work Intake** in the Factory UI:


.env


```text
GITLAB_ACCESS_TOKEN  =  your-gitlab-access-token
GITLAB_ACCESS_TOKEN_TYPE  =  personal


JIRA_BASE_URL  =  https://your-team.atlassian.net
JIRA_EMAIL  =  you@example.com
JIRA_API_TOKEN  =  your-jira-api-token


INCIDENT_IO_API_KEY  =  your-incident-io-api-key
```


If you haven't tried[Factory](https://mastra.ai/factory) yet, get started with:


Terminal


```text
npm   create   factory@latest
```


For more information and full configuration options, see:


- [GitLab](https://factory.mastra.ai/configure/gitlab)
- [Jira](https://factory.mastra.ai/configure/jira)
- [incident.io](https://factory.mastra.ai/configure/incidentio)
- [Review items](https://factory.mastra.ai/using/reviews)
- [Troubleshooting](https://factory.mastra.ai/troubleshooting)
